name: @papercupai/slack-notifier
description: Post a message to a Slack channel on mission-done, action-failed, or via a manual toolbar action. Demonstrates the action primitive + capability-gated http:fetch + secrets:read.
author: Papercusp

defaultChannel.description: Channel to post to when params.channel is unset.

username.description: Display name shown next to the message.

icon.description: Emoji shortcode used as the message icon.

muteOk.description: When true, on-mission-done routine fires only when status != 'ok'.

hiddenReason: Not ready yet — outbound integration is functional against a mock; live wiring against real Jira/Linear/Notion/Slack tenants is not yet verified. Hidden from marketplace until v1.0.
